llm.summary: This skill is a plain browser-automation guidance document that emphasizes tab hygiene, visible verification, and cautious fallback behavior, with no bundled code or hidden execution path.

dimensions.detail: Browser automation can interact with logged-in accounts and visible page content, but that access is expected for this skill's purpose and the artifact repeatedly requires checking the active tab, account, page state, and visible result.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The package contains SKILL.md and skill.json only, with no executable scripts, dependencies, installers, or remote payload retrieval.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The instructions are procedural and bounded to browser use; examples mention logged-in sites and actions like sending email or posting only as proof examples, not as autonomous unrelated directives.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The only persistence-like instruction is to add a short note to a platform skill or state map after confusing page behavior; it is disclosed and purpose-aligned, but users should ensure such notes do not contain sensitive account data.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is core browser operations for agents, and the instructions fit that purpose: perceive state, operate one tab per site, verify visible results, and use site-specific tools when appropriate.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you want an agent to follow disciplined browser-operation practices. Because the skill is meant for browser agents, it may guide work inside already logged-in browser sessions; review actions involving email, social posting, settings changes, or account identity before allowing them, and avoid storing sensitive details in any state-map notes.
llm.findings:
[SkillSpector] expected: SkillSpector reported no issues; artifact review found no contradictory hidden code, install behavior, or exfiltration instructions.
[AIG SARIF] expected: AIG SARIF reported no results; manual review of the Markdown and metadata found no embedded malicious code, persistence mechanism, or privilege-escalation behavior.
